assumptions.description: After one tenant funds a multi-tenant agreement, every remaining tenant eventually funds the share required to move the agreement from ReadyToFund to Active.
If multi-tenant funding stalls in ReadyToFund, the landlord eventually calls cancelProposal so already-funded tenants are credited for withdrawal.

capabilities.description: The multi-tenant agreement is in ReadyToFund and no tenant principal has yet been deposited.
At least one tenant has deposited a positive share, depositAmount and locked are positive, and the agreement remains ReadyToFund because not all tenant shares are funded.
An already-funded tenant has no unilateral transition that credits or withdraws its deposited principal while the agreement remains below Active/Closed/Cancelled.

transitions.impact: tenant principal enters escrow before the agreement becomes Active
previously deposited tenant principal can remain locked indefinitely when a co-tenant and landlord stop progressing the agreement
